gen-fs-styro-gf-tiktok-sans: Styro crowds its letters until the gaps nearly vanish, a retro, commanding look; TikTok Sans has tall lowercase and a generous c. Its sans-serif lines stay easy going.
gen-fs-styro-gf-ubuntu-sans: Styro packs its retro, commanding letters tight, with low crossbars; Ubuntu Sans brings tubular strokes and big lowercase eyes. Styro earns its keep big and brief.
gen-fs-styro-gf-yaldevi: Tight, retro and a bit bossy. Styro pinches its e shapes nearly shut, while Yaldevi, a plain sans, opens its e wide to the right and runs oversized.
gen-fs-tanker-gf-cascadia-code: Tanker curls every open curve inward, leaving very small gaps between heavy letters. Cascadia Code, a plain sans with a wire-like monoline skeleton, spaces its neighbors far apart and smooths each bend.
gen-fs-tanker-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono reads compact, its sans letters standing like pins in a wide board. Tanker above it is heavy and closed in, so the two look dense against open.
gen-fs-tanker-gf-julius-sans-one: Approachable and wide open, Julius Sans One leaves big stretches of blank space between its sans-serif letters. Tanker, heavy and tight, sits against it.
gen-fs-tanker-gf-lexend-peta: Approachable and sturdy, Lexend Peta draws sans-serif curves with no thinning and a big x-height, while Tanker stays heavy and tightly packed. Shrink Tanker and it loses its punch.
gen-fs-tanker-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates reads open, its sans-serif c as wide as a bent paperclip and its lowercase crowding the capital line. And Tanker's heavy, inward-curling letters make a long page feel tight against that openness.
gen-fs-zina-fs-asap: Asap sets a sans body whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose c forms read as open arcs. Zina's fat downstrokes and threadlike upstrokes sit above it.
gen-fs-zina-fs-merriweather-sans: Fat strokes, hairline thins. Zina's wide-set, pen-cut letters sit over Merriweather Sans, a sans-serif with tall, sturdy lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right.
